summary: The filing is a Form 6-K submitted by Greenbriar Sustainable Living Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, reporting the results of its annual general and special meeting of shareholders held on July 7, 2026. Shareholders approved all routine matters: election of six directors, appointment of Davidson Company LLP as auditor, continuation of the 10% rolling stock option plan, and adoption of advance notice provisions for director nominations. No special-situation M&A, tender offer, activism, restructuring, or other event-driven catalyst is present. This is an ordinary governance update with no transactional implications.
